name: – Dainius Žalimas – After § 17 – Am 8
title: REPORT on monitoring the application of European Union law in 2023, 2024 and 2025
part_text: 17a. Stresses the need to safeguard the national identities of the Member States and their right to maintain public order and to preserve their national security, in accordance with Article 4 TEU and the other specific derogations provided for in the TFEU; recalls that national security remains the sole responsibility of each Member State; considers that, where a Member State duly invokes such Treaty-based derogations, the Commission should fully respect the margin of discretion enjoyed by the Member States;
